description: Queue a Backsies backup for a hosted website now: everything (default), files only or databases only (contents), with an optional short label shown on the backup. Confirm required; the confirm returns runId for oma_backsies_status. Returns a proposal + confirmToken; call oma_confirm_tool next.

contents.description: What to back up; both when left out.

domain.description: Site domain, e.g. example.fi, instead of serviceId.

label.description: Short note shown on the backup, e.g. before theme update.

serviceId.description: OMA hosting service id. Pass this or domain.

name: oma_backsies_run
title: Back up website now
